verdict.rationale: Convertio's developer docs list 'Official Wrappers' with a PHP library on GitHub, plus an official CLI, so first-party SDK support exists. The evidence shows only PHP, and the 'feel free to improve and modify them' wording suggests lightly maintained wrappers. No OpenAPI spec was found from which other SDKs could be generated. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs in other major languages (e.g. Python, Node), documentation of SDK depth or maintenance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
